edit.description: New free helper beside `declared_kinds_with_overlaid` — the one home for 'take a custom row's lift off the run's published effective kind set': it looks the bare row name up in the `declared_kinds` map and refuses loud with the single sentence when absent. Returns a borrow (`&CustomKind`) so `gate` needs no clone and `read` adds its own `.clone()`. The four-line justification comment both call sites now carry — the lookup is total because both range over the identical `partition_kind_rows` split — folds into the helper's doc, dropping the per-site 'a fourth time' / 'a second time' count that drifts with every new lift site. Plus the unit test under this file's `mod tests` that pins both arms.

The custom-row loop at 344-354 (`let custom_kind = declared_kinds.get(&row.name).ok_or_else(|| miette::miette!(...))?;`) calls the new compose helper instead of spelling the lookup and its refusal sentence. It wants the borrow, so the `?` keeps yielding `&CustomKind` and the `kind_units_and_features` call below is unchanged.

`explain_target`'s twin at 2383-2396 — the same `.get(&row.name).ok_or_else(...)` with the identical sentence, added by 78763f02 — calls the same helper and keeps its `.clone()` (it owns `custom_kind` for the `CustomMember` rows it pushes).

summary: The 'declared by the lock but absent from the run's effective kind set' refusal is spelled twice — gate's custom-row loop and explain's — one sentence, two homes.

tests.asserts: new unit test over the helper: a map holding the name yields that kind's lift, and a map missing it refuses with the one sentence naming the kind — the pin neither call site can carry, since both lookups are total by construction and no synthetic reaches them through the verbs.
`a_locked_custom_kinds_members_are_counted_beside_the_built_ins` stays green — the gate's happy arm now reaching its lift through the shared helper.

acceptance: cargo test and cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings green, and `rg "absent from the run's effective kind set" src/` returns exactly one site — the new compose helper — with both callers reaching the published lift through it.
notes: Found by the residue sweep over 2dfc9cc5..d2020863; 78763f02's own body names the duplication ('mirroring the total lookup and loud fallback 50626fba left in gate's twin loop'). Sentence census by text, not by helper name: exactly two sites (src/gate.rs:351, src/read.rs:2391), no test or snapshot carries it. `explain_target` has no end-to-end test, so its arm rides cargo build + clippy — hence the compose unit test as the fold's pin. scoped at d2020863
